description: GEDTM30 v1.2 (CC-BY 4.0) — global ensemble bare-earth DTM (ICESat-2/GEDI-fused, strips the building/canopy noise GLO-30's surface model bakes into ground elevation). Distributed as one global Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF; cropped to South Korea's coverage bbox directly from the remote file via gdalwarp -te over HTTP range requests (/vsicurl/), no manual per-tile portal download the way GLO-30 needed.

acquisition.note: provider.url is a real, directly fetchable COG (unlike GLO-30's OpenTopography source, an interactive portal page) — the setup script warps straight from it, no local raw-file staging step.
